projectWindows.repositoryRevealFailed.en: [project-window] Could not reveal the repository in Explorer: {{value}}
projectWindows.repositoryRevealFailed.zh-CN: [project-window] 无法在资源管理器中定位仓库：{{value}}

projectWindows.trustTheProjectWorkspaceB.en: Trust the project workspace before opening it from AlwayGit.
projectWindows.trustTheProjectWorkspaceB.zh-CN: 从 AlwayGit 打开项目前，请先信任项目工作区。

projectWindows.theRepositoryDirectoryCha.en: The repository directory changed. Reopen it from AlwayGit.
projectWindows.theRepositoryDirectoryCha.zh-CN: 仓库目录已变化，请从 AlwayGit 重新打开。

projectWindows.theProjectWindowHasNoWork.en: The project window has no workspace to activate.
projectWindows.theProjectWindowHasNoWork.zh-CN: 项目窗口中没有可激活的工作区。

projectWindows.vSCodeCouldNotActivateThe.en: VS Code could not activate the selected project window. Switch to that window and try again.
projectWindows.vSCodeCouldNotActivateThe.zh-CN: VS Code 无法激活所选项目窗口。请切换到该窗口后重试。

projectWindows.aWindowLevelRequestCannot.en: A window-level request cannot be routed as a project request.
projectWindows.aWindowLevelRequestCannot.zh-CN: 窗口级请求不能作为项目请求路由。

projectWindows.theProjectWasOpenedButAlw.en: The project was opened, but AlwayGit did not respond. Enable AlwayGit and trust that project window, then try again.
projectWindows.theProjectWasOpenedButAlw.zh-CN: 项目已打开，但 AlwayGit 未响应。请在该项目窗口中启用 AlwayGit 并信任工作区，然后重试。

projectWindows.theProjectWasOpenedInANew.en: The project was opened in a new window, but AlwayGit did not respond. Enable AlwayGit and trust that project window, then try again.
projectWindows.theProjectWasOpenedInANew.zh-CN: 项目已在新窗口中打开，但 AlwayGit 未响应。请在该项目窗口中启用 AlwayGit 并信任工作区，然后重试。

projectWindows.theNewWindowOpenedButAlwa.en: The new window opened, but AlwayGit did not respond. Enable AlwayGit in that window, then try again.
projectWindows.theNewWindowOpenedButAlwa.zh-CN: 新窗口已打开，但 AlwayGit 未响应。请在该窗口中启用 AlwayGit，然后重试。
